quotes.line: The all-India average retail price of onion is Rs 53.78 per kg.

The all-India average retail price of onion stood at ₹52.99 per kg on October 10, marginally lower than ₹53.10 per kg a month ago and significantly higher than ₹26.65 a year ago, according to government data. Similarly, wholesale prices averaged ₹4,591 per quintal, up 2.4% over the past month and 123.3% from a year earlier.
Onion prices have nearly doubled over the past year, rising 96.06 per cent to Rs 52.70 per kg as of October 16, 2026.
This year, the government procured 121,000 tonnes of rabi onion for its 2026-27 buffer stock, against a target of 200,000 tonnes, and began releasing onions at Rs 35 per kg.
Despite the fall in wholesale prices, retail rates for good-quality onions continue to remain high at around ₹65 per kg.

सरकार आम लोगों को सस्ते दामों पर प्याज केवल दिवाली तक ही उपलब्ध कराएगी। इसके बाद सस्ती प्याज की बिक्री बंद कर दी जाएगी। वर्तमान में 100 से अधिक शहरों में नैफेड और एनसीसीएफ द्वारा प्याज की खुदरा बिक्री 35 रुपये प्रति किलो के हिसाब से की जा रही है। हालांकि इसके बावजूद प्याज के थोक और खुदरा भाव में कोई ज्यादा गिरावट नहीं आई है।

उपभोक्ता मामलों के विभाग के मुताबिक प्याज का अखिल भारतीय खुदरा औसत मूल्य 10 अक्तूबर को 51.71 रुपये प्रति किलो दर्ज किया गया। एक साल पहले प्याज का भाव 26.73 रुपये प्रति किलो था। नोएडा और दिल्ली में अच्छी गुणवत्ता का प्याज 80 रुपये प्रति किलो तक बिक रहा है।

Tomato farmers in Nashik are facing a double blow as drought conditions and a supply glut drive down prices at Pimpalgaon APMC. Wholesale rates have fallen nearly 65% in a week to Rs 111 per 20-kg crate, while retail prices have dropped 50% to Rs 20 per kg.

Tomato was selling at Rs 42 per kg on Monday, compared with Rs 36 a year ago.Trade sources attributed the rise in onion prices to estimates of a 5-7% decline in kharif onion production in Maharashtra, the country’s largest onion-producing state, due to a reduction in acreage and delayed monsoon rains.

Tomato prices were recorded at Rs 40.74 per kg, against Rs 42.70 a week earlier, Rs 38.96 a month earlier and Rs 38.65 a year earlier. The price declined 4.59 per cent over the week but rose 4.57 per cent over the month and 5.41 per cent over the year. This pattern points to a recent correction following a monthly increase, rather than a sustained decline across all comparison periods.
Potato prices have declined over 10% to Rs 22.72/kg compared to the previous year while tomato prices have increased to Rs 42.7/kg, a 10% year-on-year decline.
The price of domestic LPG cylinders used by households remains unchanged at ₹942 per 14.2-kg cylinder in Delhi.

prev_month_quotes.quote: The all-India average retail price of onion was  ₹53.86 per kg on September 18. (HT Photo)")
The all-India average retail price of onion was ₹53.86 per kg on September 18, 95% higher than the ₹27.6 a year earlier, according to Department of Consumer Affairs data.

The latest increase was over a period of just three months. The average retail onion price across states rose from ₹29.5 per kg on 1 June to ₹56.1 per kg on 10 September, a 90% increase in just over three months.
On September 5, onions were retailing at ₹58 per kg in Delhi, ₹53 per kg in Mumbai, ₹63 per kg in Chennai and ₹40 per kg in Ranchi, while the average wholesale price stood at ₹42.79 per kg.
